dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, continuous 2D geometric narrowing from the widest point of the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle tip.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white skin tone with normalized pixel intensity consistent with an adult phenotype, filtering for lateral shading.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A linear sequence of small, dark, high-contrast marks situated specifically along the posterior segment of the dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Small, regular topological notches along the midline of the posterior dorsal ridge causing localized shadow-casting.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A sequence of small, dark, segmented markings or scars along the posterior dorsal ridge axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, shadowed dorsal ridge with distinct periodic dark pigmentations.
